claims.text: A refined nanostructure combining fine grains with uniformly distributed nano-precipitates governs strong magnetocaloric response at low applied fields in rare-earth-free HEAs.
Nano-precipitates serve as local magnetoelastic sites.
Fine grains and nano-precipitates reduce local energy barriers for spin reorientation.
The refined nanostructure facilitates a nearly second-order magnetic phase transition.
The refined nanostructure promotes high magnetic entropy change at low applied fields.
The refined nanostructure supports rapid heat exchange.
The refined nanostructure supports low magnetic hysteresis.
The refined nanostructure supports mechanical stability.
SLM-built CoCrFeMnNi alloys exhibit a fine grain structure and nanoscale precipitates resembling the proposed initial state.
Controlled post-synthesis heat treatment can incrementally coarsen or partially dissolve the nano-precipitates.
The proposed heat treatment alters grain-boundary density and precipitate-size distribution.
Local precipitate-induced strain fields lower the energy barrier for magnetic-domain reorientation.
Lower domain-reorientation barriers produce a strong, reversible magnetocaloric effect with minimal hysteresis.
Fine grain structure promotes efficient thermal conduction.
Fine grain structure maintains mechanical integrity under cyclic loading.
Relative to prolonged-annealed samples with coarser precipitates and larger grains, samples retaining the refined nanostructure will have significantly higher low-field magnetic entropy change.
Relative to the prolonged-annealed baseline, samples retaining the refined nanostructure will have lower magnetic hysteresis.
Relative to the prolonged-annealed baseline, samples retaining the refined nanostructure will preserve mechanical stability.
Relative to the prolonged-annealed baseline, samples retaining the refined nanostructure will maintain rapid heat exchange.
The proposed relationship is expected to hold near the magnetic transition, typically around room temperature, at fields below 1 T and within compositions similar to the experimental alloy system.
